title: On Proceeding with the plan despite the rain
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：proceed　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 proceed 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the builder ① proceeded with the plan despite the rain in the rain, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② proceeds with the plan despite the rain without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ proceed with the plan despite the rain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ proceeded with the plan despite the rain before — a line in the plan for October 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Proceeding with the plan despite the rain in the rain, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ proceed to the village at a steady pace without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Proceed to the village at a steady pace at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ proceeds to the village at a steady pace in the rain every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ proceeded with the plan despite the rain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To proceed with the plan despite the rain, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody proceeds with the plan despite the rain without complaint again and somebody must proceed with the plan despite the rain in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 继续（一般过去式 proceeded with the plan despite the rain：1962 年施工员头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 继续（一般现在 proceeds with the plan despite the rain：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 继续（不定式 to proceed with the plan despite the rain：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 继续（过去完成时 had proceeded with the plan despite the rain：1956 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 继续（动名词 proceeding with the plan despite the rain 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 缓行（proceed to the village at a steady pace：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去缓行步子稳稳地往村子去）
G. v. 缓行（proceed to the village at a steady pace：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 继续（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 proceeds to the village at a steady pace，而母亲又一次 proceeded with the plan despite the rain）

answers.why: proceed 意为“继续”，1962 年施工员淋着雨继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 proceeded。
proceed 意为“继续”，自那以后施工员毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 proceeds。
proceed 意为“继续”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案”，此处为不定式 to proceed with the plan despite the rain。
proceed 意为“继续”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人继续过，故用过去完成时 had proceeded。
proceed 意为“继续”，施工员说“继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 proceeding with the plan despite the rain 作主语。
proceed 意为“缓行”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去缓行步子稳稳地往村子去”，should ever 之后用原形 proceed to the village at a steady pace。
proceed 意为“缓行”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻缓行步子稳稳地往村子去（proceed to the village at a steady pace at once），以后再也不要提起。
proceed 意为“继续”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例缓行步子稳稳地往村子去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 proceeds。
proceed 意为“继续”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案，用一般过去式 proceeded 叙述。
proceed 意为“继续”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

items: 1962 年，施工员淋着雨继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（proceeded with the plan despite the rain）
多年以后，施工员仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（proceeds with the plan despite the rain）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案这件事本身。（to proceed with the plan despite the rain）
早在 1956 年就有人继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had proceeded with the plan despite the rain）
施工员说过，淋着雨继续顾不得下雨照旧推进那方案这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（proceeding with the plan despite the rain 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻缓行步子稳稳地往村子去，以后再也不要提起。（proceed to the village at a steady pace，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 proceed 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the builder proceeded with the plan despite the rain in the rain, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder proceeds with the plan despite the rain without complaint whenever the site asks.
Proceeding with the plan despite the rain in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever proceed to the village at a steady pace without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site proceeds to the village at a steady pace in the rain every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother proceeded with the plan despite the rain again, and the site remembered that half.
